Source is Novartis's own PDF copy of its Form 20-F 2024 on novartis.com (www.sec.gov not contacted); dividends, buybacks and stock comp are cross-checked against SEC XBRL companyfacts (CIK 0001114448). Novartis reports in USD; converted exactly from USD millions. LEADER: Vasant Narasimhan (CEO) held 352,526 vested shares and ADRs at December 31, 2024, plus 75,885 unvested shares and other equity rights and 213,942 unvested target PSUs (total 642,353). shares records the vested figure only. The 20-F says no Executive Committee member owned 1% or more, and gives no percentage, so pctEconomic is null. HOLDERS: BlackRock's 7.12% and UBS Fund Management's 5.9% come from the 7.A table, 'calculated on the basis of 1 975 089 248 ordinary shares outstanding', i.e. excluding treasury shares. BlackRock's figure rests on a 13G filed February 2, 2024, so asOf is that filing date (event date not given). Emasan AG's 4.1% is its registered holding as a percentage of share capital at December 31, 2024 (Item 6.C register table), a different base that includes treasury shares. The same register table shows UBS Fund Management at 5.3% of share capital. Norges Bank (2.3%, by disclosure notification) is not listed because three larger holders are. Nominees (Nortrust 3.5%, BNY Mellon 2.8%) and the ADS depositary JPMorgan (8.0%) are custodians, not beneficial owners. BUYBACKS: USD 8,331 million 'Purchases of treasury shares' (cash flow). The 20-F says the 77.5 million shares bought in 2024 for USD 8.3 billion included 68.8 million (USD 7.3 billion) under the up-to USD 15 billion buyback announced July 2023, 8.7 million (USD 1.0 billion) to offset share deliveries under employee equity plans, and 1.2 million bought back from employees. The plan-related part (about USD 1.0 billion plus USD 0.1 billion) is given only in rounded billions, so it cannot be split out exactly and the full cash-flow figure is kept; the programme-only amount would be about USD 7.3 billion. DIVIDENDS: USD 7,624 million to shareholders of Novartis AG. STOCK COMP: USD 1,307 million 'Expense related to equity-based participation plans' (continuing operations). GEOGRAPHY: net sales only (USD 50,317 million); other revenues are not included.
